worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.summary: Hold the skill key for a short charged hop; release to lock your current line and slam the built charge into the first enemy you touch. Three tiers at 6/12/18 ticks off the ground - the longer you hold the harder it shocks, and it auto-drops at full charge. A whiff or a wall costs you a share of your maximum health.
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.descript: A full-charge hit deals about %1$s contact damage; the actual hit is scaled by the charge tier (.65/.82/1), and the target's defence, Electric match-up and crits are settled when it lands. Only the first non-allied living thing on the dive is settled.

Hold the skill key and leave the ground to charge: %1$s s airborne gives the first tier (65%% power), %2$s s the second (82%%), and %3$s s the full tier (100%%) which auto-drops; releasing early drops at the tier you already earned, so the sooner you let go the lighter it hits.

The short hop is about %1$s blocks high, rising at %2$s and diving at %3$s blocks per tick with %4$s blocks per tick of forward drift; this move's own bounded gravity holds only those few airborne ticks, and landing or interruption restores native gravity, so it never flies for long. Too low a ceiling means you cannot rise and cannot charge.

Cast on an enemy or a point within %1$s blocks; the diving body hits the first non-allied living thing it touches and settles there, while a wall on the way, or no contact at all, costs %2$s of your maximum health at the real landing spot.

The landing point locks only at the instant you release the key (or at full charge); you can keep adjusting the line while charging, and so can the target by moving or shooting. The dive uses the whole body's collision, settles only the first target, and never doubles back through a wall.
Pushes the target %1$s blocks along the dive; native knockback resistance still applies.
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.growth.0: From level %1$s the full-charge power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.growth.1: From level %1$s the full-charge power rises to %2$s and knockback to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.use.0: Hold to charge, release to slam the built shock on your line
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.use.1: Shove a target off you with a controlled landing
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.use.2: Gamble a full charge on a target that likes to sidestep
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.preferen: Only drop on a target within this distance; move closer otherwise. Farther than the other crash kicks, for opening pressure.
Below this health ratio the user stops using Supercell Slam (a whiff's self-hurt can be lethal). Higher is more cautious; lower takes more risk.
